selected_memories.text: When BIR-64 encounters ZIR-77, the validated terminal code becomes LOQ-84.
Official revision: for the chain involving BIR-64 and ZIR-77, the accepted terminal code is LOQ-84; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When active JOT-71 is present, it produces BIR-64.
Official rule: activating LOQ-88 converts JOT-71 into its active form.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with ZIR-77 is SIV-10.
Official rule: activating MUR-29 converts GOL-63 into its active form.
When active GOL-63 is present, it produces ZIR-20.
Official revision: for the chain involving ZIR-20 and TEK-27, the accepted terminal code is MUR-30; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with TEK-27 is HAP-65.
When ZIR-20 encounters TEK-27, the validated terminal code becomes MUR-30.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with FEN-99 is TEK-40.
When TEK-20 encounters FEN-99, the validated terminal code becomes FEN-86.
When active FEN-68 is present, it produces TEK-20.
Official rule: activating GOL-21 converts FEN-68 into its active form.
Official revision: for the chain involving TEK-20 and FEN-99, the accepted terminal code is FEN-86; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.

derived_relations.claim: Activating LOQ-88 converts JOT-71 into its active form, which then produces BIR-64, and activating BIR-64 converts JOT-71 into its active form, leading to the production of LOQ-84 when encountering ZIR-77.
